_comment: Illustrative sample feed for demo purposes. IPs are from RFC 5737 documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24) -- reserved for examples, never real/routable. The hash is the EICAR test file's published MD5, a standard harmless string used specifically to test antivirus/security tooling, not real malware.

192.0.2.55.notes: Example: known C2 server (documentation IP, not real)

198.51.100.23.notes: Example: Tor exit node used in a prior incident (documentation IP, not real)

203.0.113.7.notes: Example: scanning source seen in honeypot logs (documentation IP, not real)

malicious-example.test.notes: Example phishing domain (reserved .test TLD, not a real registrable domain)

evil-c2.example.notes: Example C2 domain (reserved .example TLD, not real)

44d88612fea8a8f36de82e1278abb02f.notes: EICAR standard antivirus test file (MD5) -- intentionally harmless, used to test detection tooling
